Uday Joshi | uday.joshi279@example.com | +91 9100044618
Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

Professional Summary
Senior DevOps/Site Reliability Engineer with strong experience designing, deploying, and operating scalable infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines. Proven track record delivering production-ready platforms, improving system reliability, and reducing deployment lead time through automation and observability. Open to relocating to Delhi NCR.

Technical Skills
Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, Jenkins, Grafana, Ansible, Linux, Confluence

Work Experience

Senior DevOps Engineer, Paystack India (Feb 2024 - Present)
- Implemented Kubernetes-based platform for payment microservices, containerizing services with Docker and establishing environment standards, reducing onboarding time for new services by 35% using Confluence-run playbooks.
- Built end-to-end observability using Grafana dashboards and alerting to track payment transaction latency and error rates, cutting incident MTTR by 40%.
- Automated configuration management and routine maintenance with Ansible playbooks for node provisioning and application rollouts across clusters.

Site Reliability Engineer, Cognizant (Aug 2023 - Jan 2024)
- Standardized Docker images and streamlined CI pipelines to accelerate delivery of enterprise applications, decreasing build failures by 25% through improved base image controls and Confluence documentation.
- Developed Grafana-based service health dashboards and alerts integrated with on-call workflows, improving early detection of resource saturation.
- Automated routine operational tasks and patching using Ansible, reducing manual intervention and improving compliance reporting.

Site Reliability Engineer, Orbit Health (Dec 2018 - Jul 2023)
- Designed and managed Jenkins-driven CI/CD pipelines for healthcare applications, enabling automated build, test, and deployment workflows that reduced release cycle time by 45%.
- Implemented infrastructure-as-code using Terraform to provision cloud resources and maintain consistent environments across staging and production.
- Automated server configuration, deployments, and backup routines with Ansible on Linux hosts; documented runbooks and runbook updates in Confluence to support SRE handovers.

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
